    if tenure_col:

    print(f"\n数据集大小: {df.shape}")
    print("数据预览:")
    print(df.head())

        df['hire_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['hire_date'], errors='coerce')

    if 'organization_name' in df_clean.columns and 'hire_date' in df_clean.columns:

        results['avg_tenure_by_org'] = avg_tenure_by_org
    else:
        print("\n警告: 缺少必要列，无法计算平均工作年限")
    
    return results
